segments.title: A cheetah hits up to 70 MPH
segments.say: A cheetah can hit seventy miles an hour. The fastest animal on land.

segments.title: It hunts in one burst
segments.say: It hunts by outrunning its prey in one burst of speed.

segments.title: Far fewer than in 1900
segments.say: In nineteen hundred, about a hundred thousand lived in Africa. Today, far fewer.
Follow. Weird Animal number 36 drops tonight at 8.
